narrative.overview:
A near-black page with one cool cyan signal. Content sits on faint glass panels that light up under the pointer, the way a ledger page answers a finger running down it. The site is dark-only today; a light theme is planned beside it, so colour roles below are named by role, not by "dark".

The tone is calm and exact. Text is dense and factual, because readers come to check a record: publications, roles, references. Decoration is limited to glass, a soft glow, and one accent. Nothing competes with the facts.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (signal cyan) on a near-black ground, with soft grey text tiers.
Glass surfaces: translucent fills, hairline borders, backdrop blur.
Pill shapes for controls, 16px rounding for cards.
Pointer-following glow on cards, desktop only.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only accent for state and emphasis. A new surface does not introduce a second action colour.

rules.name: The Role Tint Rule
rules.body: Accent fills behind text are tints (10% highlight, 15 to 20% active, 30% border, 60% on the selected tab). Solid cyan is for small marks (list bullets, the section accent bar), the glass button focus ring and the single 404 home button, which carries dark text.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and colour (light vs grey), with few size steps.

rules.name: The Glass Rule
rules.body: Floating chrome (nav, mobile menu, glow cards) uses blur, a translucent fill and a hairline border, not an opaque fill. The portfolio card is the one exception, because it carries a full-width image.

dos: Do use Signal Cyan (#03b1fb) as the only accent, as a tint for fills behind text.
Do build floating surfaces from a translucent fill, blur and a hairline border: white at 10 to 20%, or the fill's own grey on glow cards.
Do make small controls full pills and cards 16px.
Do keep grey tiers: Paper Light for headings, Text Soft or 200 to 300 for body, Text Muted for metadata.
Do disable pointer glow below 768px and keep touch panning and pinch zoom intact.

Do give every link and button a 44px tap target at 360px, except links inside running text, the link lists in an Experience card's Links tab, and the skip link. Where neighbours sit closer than 44px (icon rows, footer lists, wrapped chips) the areas share the space. The visible size stays small: the extra area is padding offset by a negative margin, or a pseudo-element where a parent's spacing would clash.
Do keep the page usable with one dark theme now and a light theme later: reference colour roles, not literal values, in new components.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue outside the badge set.
Don't fill areas behind text with solid cyan, beyond the 404 home button, or use opaque light panels on the dark ground.
Don't introduce a new typeface; Poppins only.
Don't rely on hover alone for meaning; phones are a main reader.
